lines.zh: 晶圓針測：探針卡一格一格地點測晶粒。
lines.en: Wafer sort: a probe card testing the wafer, die by die.

lines.zh: 補強板、主板、MLO 載板、板背支撐，這四層是 DIS 做的。
lines.en: Stiffener, main PCB, MLO substrate, backer — the four layers DIS builds.

lines.zh: 追一條訊號：測試機、主板、MLO 載板，
lines.en: Follow one signal: tester, main PCB, MLO substrate,

lines.zh: 最後從探針落到晶粒上。
lines.en: and finally down a probe onto the die.

lines.zh: 時間快轉十倍，晶圓圖一下子就填滿了。
lines.en: Fast-forward ten times and the wafer map fills right in.

lines.zh: 剖開探針頭：兩片導板中間，夾著一排排垂直探針。
lines.en: Cut the probe head open: rows of vertical probes between two guide plates.

lines.zh: 載台頂上來，針尖碰到鋁墊還要再壓，這叫過驅量；
lines.en: The chuck rises; after touching the pad it keeps pushing — that's overdrive.

lines.zh: 探針彎曲，針尖在鋁墊上刮出針痕。
lines.en: The probes bend and every tip scrubs a mark into its pad.

lines.zh: 右邊：同樣過驅量下，懸臂針對垂直針。
lines.en: On the right: cantilever vs vertical at the same overdrive.

lines.zh: 凍結時間，讓 MLO 載板翹曲一百微米。
lines.en: Freeze time and warp the MLO substrate by 100 μm.

lines.zh: 翹起那一側的探針碰不到晶粒，變紅了。
lines.en: Probes on the high side no longer reach the die — they turn red.

lines.zh: 那就加大過驅量來補償⋯⋯
lines.en: So crank up the overdrive to compensate…

lines.zh: 懸臂針刮出鋁墊、彎到回不來，垂直探針也超過降伏——壞了。
lines.en: The cantilever scrubs off the pad and bends for good, the vertical probes pass yield — broken.

lines.zh: 下一步，我想找出它的極限，所以會做成遊戲。
lines.en: Next I want to find where it breaks, so a game is coming.

lines.zh: 用 Claude Opus 5.5 做的，直接在瀏覽器裡就能玩。
lines.en: Built with Claude Opus 5.5 — it runs live in your browser.
